open('programs/task-295c7e3f.py','w').write('''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g = grid
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    BG = max((v for v in cnt if v != 9), key=lambda v: cnt[v])
    lrows = [i for i in range(h) if 9 not in g[i]]
    lcols = [j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j] != 9 for i in range(h))]
    rects = []
    for a in range(len(lrows)):
        for b in range(a + 1, len(lrows)):
            r1, r2 = lrows[a], lrows[b]
            for c in range(len(lcols)):
                for d in range(c + 1, len(lcols)):
                    c1, c2 = lcols[c], lcols[d]
                    cells = [g[i][j] for i in (r1, r2) for j in lcols if c1 <= j <= c2] + \\
                            [g[i][j] for j in (c1, c2) for i in lrows if r1 <= i <= r2]
                    s = set(cells)
                    if len(s) == 1 and next(iter(s)) not in (BG, 9):
                        rects.append((r1, c1, r2, c2, next(iter(s))))
    if not rects:
        return [[9]]
    rmin = min(r[0] for r in rects); rmax = max(r[2] for r in rects)
    cmin = min(r[1] for r in rects); cmax = max(r[3] for r in rects)
    lr = [x for x in lrows if rmin <= x <= rmax]
    lc = [x for x in lcols if cmin <= x <= cmax]
    out = [[9] * (len(lc) - 1) for _ in range(len(lr) - 1)]
    for ri in range(len(lr) - 1):
        for ci in range(len(lc) - 1):
            r1, r2, c1, c2 = lr[ri], lr[ri + 1], lc[ci], lc[ci + 1]
            for (R1, C1, R2, C2, col) in rects:
                if R1 <= r1 and r2 <= R2 and C1 <= c1 and c2 <= C2:
                    out[ri][ci] = col
    return out
''')
